intro: Explore a breathtaking underwater world as dolphins Jupiter and Mars.
description:
Experience Jupiter & Mars like never before in the Definitive Edition, newly reimagined for Nintendo Switch™.

Take the plunge with Jupiter and Mars, two dolphins on the adventure of a lifetime through a vibrant underwater world. This new Definitive Edition introduces an all-new third-person perspective that brings both dolphins on screen together, putting their relationship at the heart of the adventure.

Swim through stunning ocean environments, encounter incredible marine life, and uncover hidden secrets beneath the waves. Use echolocation to reveal the world around you, interact with sea creatures, solve environmental puzzles, and journey alongside your dolphin companion as you venture deeper into the unknown.

The oceans need help, and Jupiter and Mars may be their only hope.

Enhanced and expanded for Nintendo Switch™, Jupiter & Mars: Definitive Edition is the ultimate way to experience their unforgettable ocean adventure.
